articles.title: Manufacturers Launch 340B Rebate Pilot Programs
articles.summary: Pharmaceutical manufacturers are rolling out new 340B rebate pilot initiatives, shifting how covered entities and contract pharmacies manage pricing. This development impacts drug distribution channels and overall program integrity, which heavily influence pharmacy benefit management and commercial health plan costs.

articles.title: Gross-to-Net Realities Highlight Evolving Drug Channel Pricing Dynamics
articles.summary: An analysis of 2025 gross-to-net pricing data from top drugmakers examines the shifting dynamics of the net pricing drug channel. This data is critical for self-funded employers and PBMs evaluating net versus gross drug spend and rebate structures. Understanding these trends helps plan sponsors better manage escalating specialty and brand drug costs.
articles.source_line: Source: Drug Channels; Wed, 07 Oct 2026 09:30:00 GMT

articles.title: Rising Pharmacy Benefit Rebates Fail to Curb Climbing Employer Drug Costs
articles.summary: As pharmacy benefit rebates continue to rise, self-funded employers report that overall drug costs keep climbing unabated. This trend underscores ongoing frustrations with PBM pricing transparency and net versus gross drug spend management. The dynamic reinforces the strategic importance for employers to evaluate transparent, pass-through PBM models to capture true savings.
articles.source_line: Source: Human Resources Director; Wed, 07 Oct 2026 01:40:14 GMT

articles.title: PBM Transparency Gaps Challenge Employer Cost-Containment Efforts
articles.summary: Despite ongoing regulatory scrutiny, pharmacy benefit managers continue to maintain opaque pricing practices that make it difficult for self-funded employers to control drug spend. The article examines actionable strategies for plan sponsors to demand greater contract clarity and rein in rising pharmacy costs.
articles.source_line: Source: MedCity News; Wed, 07 Oct 2026 13:45:52 GMT

articles.title: Congress Targets PBM and Broker Payments Amid Employer Drug Market Shifts
articles.summary: Lawmakers are increasingly scrutinizing financial arrangements between pharmacy benefit managers and brokers, focusing on how hidden fees impact self-funded employer health plan costs. This legislative attention signals potential regulatory changes for employer drug benefit distribution and transparency.
articles.source_line: Source: Insurance Business; Wed, 07 Oct 2026 11:07:25 GMT

articles.title: Clarventa Launches TrueNet to Reshape Prescription Drug Pricing Models
articles.summary: Clarventa has announced TrueNet, a novel approach aimed at reforming prescription drug pricing and transparency for self-funded health plans. This launch reflects ongoing market pressure for alternative pricing models that challenge traditional PBM structures. The development is strategically important for employers seeking greater transparency and cost predictability in their pharmacy benefits.
articles.source_line: Source: Business Wire; Wed, 07 Oct 2026 12:00:00 GMT

articles.title: Virta Health Reaches Profitability Amid Growing Employer Adoption
articles.summary: Virta Health announced it has reached profitability and now serves over 750 organizations, highlighting strong employer demand for digital health solutions targeting chronic conditions like type 2 diabetes. This growth reflects how self-funded employers are increasingly partnering with specialized point solutions to manage high-cost metabolic diseases and potentially offset soaring pharmacy spend. The milestone underscores the expanding market for integrated chronic disease management within employer-sponsored health plans.
